item.title: How To Heal A Broken Heart: A Collection of Music
item.description: Music has a way of reaching the inner depths of a person’s soul without having to know a thing. For a girl who vanishes into her mind too often than she would like to admit, the art and feelings expressed through music is cathartic. This music is a collection of every step it took to heal this broken heart. <p>The post How To Heal A Broken Heart: A Collection of Music first appeared on Her Campus.</p>

item.title: The Quiet Way Friendships Fall Apart
item.description: Most friendships don’t end in a single, dramatic moment. They fade quietly, worn down by mismatched growth, unspoken expectations, and the assumption that history alone is enough to hold two people together. What lingers afterward isn’t confusion about what went wrong, but grief for what once felt permanent. <p>The post The Quiet Way Friendships Fall Apart first appeared on Her Campus.</p>
